Citation: Huot et al. (2022), IEEE TGRS, DOI: 10.1109/TGRS.2022.3192974
Problem: Next-day wildfire spread binary classification on 1km grid
Data: Google Research Wildfire Spread dataset, CONUS 2012-2020, 64x64 patches, severe class imbalance (<3% positive)
Inputs/features: 12 environmental variables: weather (ERA5), topography (SRTM), vegetation (MODIS NDVI/landcover), drought (GridMET PDSI/ERC), previous fire mask (VIIRS)
Method: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, benchmark 2D CNN
Validation: Spatially and temporally separated evaluation sets
Metrics/results: PR-AUC, ROC-AUC; CNN improved over tabular baselines
Limitations: Limited to CONUS; deep CNN computationally demanding; fixed spatial patch window
Relevance to us: Direct benchmark dataset and baseline comparison for our tabular pipeline

Problem: Wildfire susceptibility mapping over 21-year historical fire records
Data: Liguria Region (Italy), 1997-2017 historical wildfire inventory, static environmental grid
Inputs/features: Geo-environmental variables: land cover, topography (elevation, slope, aspect), road proximity
Metrics/results: AUC-ROC, Sensitivity, Specificity, Feature Importance rankings
Limitations: Static susceptibility only; does not predict dynamic daily spread; lacks dynamic weather inputs
Relevance to us: Demonstrates high predictive power of terrain and landcover features in tabular tree models

Citation: Jain et al. (2020), Environmental Reviews, DOI: 10.1139/er-2020-0019
Problem: Systematic review of ML across wildfire science domains (ignitions, spread, susceptibility, effects)
Data: Synthesis of ~300 peer-reviewed papers across global fire regimes
Inputs/features: Remote sensing data, weather metrics, fuel moisture, historical perimeters
Method: Random Forest, ANN, SVM, MaxEnt, CNN
Validation: Varied (often compromised by spatial autocorrelation / leakage)
Limitations: Identifies lack of spatial/temporal split rigor and persistent severe class imbalance in prior works
Relevance to us: Guides our strict leakage prevention protocol and choice of PR-AUC / precision-recall metrics

Data: ISBI EM segmentation challenge, microscopy imagery
Method: U-Net: Contracting path (encoder) with symmetric expanding path (decoder) and skip connections
Limitations: Requires 2D spatial context; heavy compute footprint compared to tabular trees
Relevance to us: Informs Phase 2 architecture and motivates our tabular benchmark in Phase 1
